modes.name: Zombie
modes.note: Class confirmed to exist (2026-09-07, via LoadAsset+StaticFindObject). Per the app maintainer's own knowledge of the game (2026-09-07, not independently live-confirmed by hosting into it): the content isn't actually implemented/updated in the current build, only the class reference and supporting data (DT_ZombieMapInfo, DT_UI_ZombieMaps rows 'Assylum'/'Village') exist. Not worth live-testing further -- see gamemodes.json's status comment for what no_content means.

modes.name: Pit
modes.note: Class confirmed to exist (2026-09-07). Per the app maintainer's own knowledge of the game (2026-09-07, not independently live-confirmed): content isn't implemented/updated, only the class reference and DT_UI_PitMaps rows 'Pit'/'Logistics' exist. Not worth live-testing further.

modes.name: OnlyPistol
modes.note: Class confirmed to exist (2026-09-07). Travel attempts on the known-good AirSoft map did not engage the class (stayed on GM_Bodycam_C), consistent with the app maintainer's own knowledge of the game: the content isn't implemented/updated, only the class reference exists. Not worth live-testing further.

modes.name: Training
modes.note: Confirmed live 2026-09-07: hosting this on 'Shooting Range' changes the level (get_current_level_name() correctly shows ShootingRange) but the gamemode never actually switches (get_live_state() still reports GM_Bodycam_C) -- i.e. the class exists but isn't wired up as a real hostable mode, not a bug in working content. Practical result of trying anyway: falling endlessly with no way out but quitting. Likely a practice-range backdrop not meant to be entered via servertravel. Do not use from the Host tab.
